name: Kururugi Haruruka
source: An all‐rounder who works with [url=/c151230]Urara[/url]. Because "talking is bothersome," she uses a self-made text-to-speech program called "Yondamon" to communicate with others. However, depending on the time and situation, she sometimes talk directly with others. At that time, her words are a bit inarticulately.
